verdict.rationale: Expensify's own GitHub repository (Expensify/App) documents installing dependencies and running the app locally, which shows the app's source is publicly readable. However, nothing in the evidence states which license covers it, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the repository, evidence on whether the backend is covered or only the client app, and independent corroboration of openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Run the specific platform with the following command: `npm run <platform>`, e.g. `npm run web`
`npm run web` serves the app through the local Worker at `https://dev.new.expensify.com:8082/`, with CSP, security headers, React Fast Refresh
